newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dlr lapses into lethargy as range holds.
newsitem.headline: Australian dlr lapses into lethargy as range holds.

text.p: The Australian dollar lapsed into lethargy at the midsession as bears and bulls called a truce after a week of tough but indecisive struggle.

It made a half-hearted stab at the upside this morning after bouncing from solid US$0.7560 support on the back of corporate and Swiss bank buying. But offshore offers, particularly from German and U.S. banks, smothered the rally at US$0.7620.

Dealers felt the market was still short overall so saw scope for a further squeeze higher short term, but doubted the dollar could get much past US$0.7680 given the risk interest rates here will yet head lower while the U.S. keeps a tightening bias.

By 12.15 pm (0215 GMT) the local currency was loitering at US$0.7603/08 having been repelled from a US$0.7617 high this morning. Overnight it had crept up from a US$0.7575/80 local finish and a US$0.7560 low.
On the crosses it recouped some ground to 88.10/20 yen after slipping more than 1/2 yen Thursday to 87.77/87 on the back of Japanese selling and a retreat in US$/yen.
In trade weighted terms it shifted up to 58.0 from a previous 57.7 close.
